page.overview:
What is Lake Verity?

Lake Verity is a location introduced in Generation IV.

Lake Verity is one of the three legendary lakes of Sinnoh. Located near Twinleaf Town, the lake is home to the Legendary Pokémon Mesprit, one of the three Lake Guardians and the Being of Emotion.

In Pokémon Legends : Arceus, it is part of the Obsidian Fieldlands. Volo states that it has been formed after a volcanic eruption.

For the informations about Lake Verity in Pokémon Legends : Arceus, please go to the following article : Lake Verity (Hisui).
